purpose: Prevent subgroup genetic-response inspection until the Palearctic-Lepidoptera LGM predictor and exact subgroup inferential geometry are qualified.
required_before_subgroup_response_extrac: formal Palearctic eligibility PASS with at least 20 species
TTF-Q information-survival and concentration diagnostics frozen
exact subgroup synthetic null qualification PASS
exact subgroup conditional detectability judged adequate under the predeclared envelope rule

genetic_target_if_opened.existing_response: endpoint-safe post-IBD within-species genetic turnover on the already frozen graph edges
genetic_target_if_opened.primary_comparison: Does restricting/weighting source species by higher R_refugia improve held-out target turnover prediction relative to a current-geography/current-climate matched baseline?

interpretation.qualified_positive: within this Palearctic Lepidoptera subgroup, similarity of LGM-to-present climatic persistence carries information about reusable locations of post-IBD genetic differentiation beyond present geography and climate
interpretation.qualified_null: no detectable increment under the frozen subgroup and effect domain; not proof that shared refugia never matter
interpretation.qualification_failure: STOP_NOT_EVALUABLE; do not inspect subgroup genetic outcomes

historical_caveat: The full 211-species response was previously opened. This is therefore a response-blindly redesigned subgroup re-analysis, not a pristine prospective confirmatory dataset.
